scene: Turning the golden key opens three transit gates along the brass wall.
picture: Side-scrolling view of the aviary station platform. On the far left, a glass pneumatic tube pod rests open. Centre-left stands the girl, windbreaker on, clutching the gold key. In the centre, an iridescent spherical bubble lift hovers. On the far right, a paint-splattered yellow tram idles with open double doors.
shown: A clear pneumatic capsule pod sitting open on tracks on the far left
An iridescent glass bubble cage floating above a brass ring in the centre
A brightly paint-splattered trolley tram waiting with open doors on the far right
